name: BZS (Beijing) Technology Development Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Specializing in intelligent logistics systems, RIAMB (Beijing) Technology Development Co., Ltd. provides end-to-end services from initial research and development through to manufacturing and full integration. The company places a particular emphasis on advanced automated three-dimensional warehouses. Its comprehensive offerings span conceptual planning, system architecture, tailored equipment production, development of control and software solutions, complete installation and setup, seamless system integration, and thorough client training. Founded in 1954, the enterprise operates from its headquarters in Beijing, China.
